sentences.text: Louis espère égaler le record de participation aux dernières élections municipales.
sentences.en: Louis hopes to match the turnout record of the last municipal elections.

sentences.text: Claire écrit à son vieil ami qu'aucun gâteau ne pourra égaler ceux de sa grand-mère.
sentences.en: Claire writes to her old friend that no cake will ever match her grandmother's.
sentences.ko: 클레르는 옛 친구에게 할머니 케이크만 한 건 없을 거라고 써요.

sentences.text: Dans ses courriers officiels, Louis emploie toujours un langage soutenu.
sentences.en: In his official letters, Louis always uses formal language.

sentences.text: Louis soupçonne une manigance de l'opposition pour retarder le vote du budget.

sentences.ko: 루이는 야당이 예산 표결을 늦추려고 꾸민 수작이라고 의심해요.

sentences.text: Dans sa lettre, Claire se souvient de leurs petites manigances pour sécher les cours de latin.

sentences.ko: 클레르는 편지에서 라틴어 수업을 빼먹으려고 꾸민 작은 꾀들을 떠올려요.

sentences.text: La photocopieuse de la mairie est encore détraquée, soupire Louis.

sentences.ko: 루이는 시청 복사기가 또 고장 났다고 한숨을 쉬어요.

sentences.text: Claire confie que sa vieille horloge est détraquée et sonne à minuit pile chaque après-midi.
sentences.en: Claire confides that her old clock is broken and strikes midnight every afternoon.
sentences.ko: 클레르는 오래된 시계가 고장 나서 오후마다 자정 종을 친다고 털어놓아요.

sentences.text: Louis choisit des bancs robustes pour la nouvelle place du marché.

sentences.text: Claire écrit qu'à quatre-vingts ans, sa mère reste d'une santé robuste.

sentences.en: Claire writes that she has finished kitting out her painting studio in the attic.

sentences.en: Louis teaches the interns to tell a complaint from a simple request for information.

sentences.en: Claire writes that a historical novel moved her with the harshness of its war scenes.
sentences.ko: 클레르는 역사 소설의 전쟁 장면이 너무 가혹해서 마음이 흔들렸다고 써요.

sentences.en: Claire mentions her nephew's first communion, where the whole family got together.

sentences.text: Le raisonnement de Louis convainc finalement les conseillers les plus sceptiques.
sentences.en: Louis's reasoning finally convinces the most skeptical councillors.

sentences.en: Louis oversees the disposal of paper archives that are no longer needed.

sentences.en: Claire follows the tennis tournament and writes about the favorite's surprise elimination.

sentences.en: Claire writes that she visited a small Orthodox church with walls covered in icons.
sentences.ko: 클레르는 벽이 성화로 가득한 작은 정교회 성당에 다녀왔다고 써요.

sentences.text: Louis entend deux conseillers comploter dans le couloir pour faire tomber l'adjoint.
sentences.en: Louis hears two councillors plotting in the corridor to bring down the deputy mayor.
sentences.ko: 루이는 복도에서 두 의원이 부시장을 끌어내리려고 모의하는 소리를 들어요.

sentences.text: Claire se souvient qu'enfants, ils aimaient comploter des farces contre leurs grands frères.
sentences.en: Claire remembers that as kids they loved plotting pranks against their big brothers.
sentences.ko: 클레르는 어릴 때 형들에게 장난칠 궁리를 하던 걸 떠올려요.

sentences.text: Louis installe les isoloirs pour l'élection présidentielle de dimanche.
sentences.en: Louis sets up the voting booths for Sunday's presidential election.
sentences.ko: 루이는 일요일 대통령 선거에 쓸 기표소를 설치해요.

sentences.text: Claire écrit qu'elle a suivi le débat présidentiel à la télévision jusqu'à minuit.
sentences.en: Claire writes that she watched the presidential debate on TV until midnight.
sentences.ko: 클레르는 대통령 후보 토론을 텔레비전으로 자정까지 봤다고 써요.

sentences.text: Pour le concert de la fanfare municipale, Louis distribue une partition à chaque musicien.
sentences.en: For the municipal brass band concert, Louis hands out a score to each musician.
sentences.ko: 루이는 시립 악단 연주회를 위해 연주자마다 악보를 나눠 줘요.

sentences.text: Claire glisse dans l'enveloppe une partition de la chanson qu'ils chantaient en colonie.
sentences.en: Claire slips into the envelope a score of the song they used to sing at summer camp.
sentences.ko: 클레르는 여름 캠프에서 부르던 노래 악보를 봉투에 넣어요.

sentences.text: Les agents de la mairie travaillent par roulement le samedi matin, précise Louis.
sentences.en: City hall staff work Saturday mornings on a rota, Louis specifies.
sentences.ko: 루이는 시청 직원들이 토요일 아침에 돌아가며 근무한다고 덧붙여요.

sentences.text: Claire explique qu'avec ses sœurs, elles gardent leur mère par roulement chaque week-end.
sentences.en: Claire explains that she and her sisters take turns looking after their mother every weekend.
sentences.ko: 클레르는 언니들과 주말마다 돌아가며 어머니를 돌본다고 설명해요.
